# TSBS DevOps — CPU Max All Hosts - 8 Hours

```{tags} reference, query-template, tsbs_devops
```

> [TSBS DevOps](../../tsbs-devops.md) benchmark · [all TSBS DevOps queries](index.md)

Maximum CPU usage across all hosts over 8 hours

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT hostname,
       MAX(usage_user) as max_user,
       MAX(usage_system) as max_system,
       MAX(usage_iowait) as max_iowait
FROM cpu
WHERE time >= '2024-01-02 12:00:00'
  AND time < '2024-01-02 20:00:00'
GROUP BY hostname
ORDER BY max_user DESC
```
